name: CodeQL exact-source analysis export
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: Same-repository open PR whose current source should be exported
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: read
  checks: read
  pull-requests: read
concurrency:
  group: codeql-analysis-export-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.pr_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  export:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      EXPORTER_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPORT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
    steps:
      - name: Reserve a fresh evidence directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/codeql-export-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Checkout the immutable exporter source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPORTER_HEAD }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exporter source before reading existing analyses
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$EXPORTER_HEAD" --output "$OUT/exporter-source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/preflight.log"
          python3 scripts/test_export_codeql_analysis.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/exporter-offline-tests.log"
      - name: Export exact PR analyses with the existing read-only token
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/export_codeql_analysis.py --out "$OUT/analysis" --wait-seconds 1200 --poll-seconds 30
      - name: Verify unchanged exporter source
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$EXPORTER_HEAD" --output "$OUT/exporter-source-after.json"
      - name: Hash all available evidence, including failures
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          out = Path(os.environ['OUT'])
          hashes = {str(p.relative_to(out)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    for p in sorted(out.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'sha256.json'}
          (out / 'sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Preserve metadata, API SARIF subsets and partial failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: codeql-analysis-export-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.OUT }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
